Process Lens/Order Lifecycle

Order Placement and Fulfillment Process

A customer order flows through validation, inventory reservation, payment capture, and fulfillment across four swimlanes.

Reading Notes

System Shape

  • Four swimlanes: Customer, Order Service, Payment Gateway, and Fulfillment.
  • Numbered steps flow top to bottom and left to right across the lanes.

Critical Flows

  • Customer submits an order; Order Service validates and reserves inventory.
  • Payment Gateway authorizes then captures funds before the order is confirmed.
  • Fulfillment packs, ships, delivers, and supports post-purchase tracking.

Operational Notes

  • Inventory reservation is released if payment capture fails.
  • Each step is idempotent so retries do not double-charge or double-ship.
Diagram type: process map Scope: order placement through fulfillment
